_about: AFFALTER SLR 722 (SLR 722 Edition): its four dials are painted into the interior's texture (interior_s_lod0, 1024 px: the speedometer to 360 km/h and the rev counter to 8,000 rpm, blue rings, each 0 at the bottom left round to the top at the bottom right; the water temperature, 40 to 120, and the fuel gauge either side, quarter dials) and their needles are modelled: thin parts of the chrome trim's material (Int_Metal, shared with the cabin's chrome: only parts under 6 cm count as needles, max_size), each with its own hub cap. Each needle turns about its hub along its painted scale (the fuel gauge's anticlockwise, empty at the right); the dials glow at night with the needles lit. The small grey discs in the two big dials' lower halves (digital_gauge1, untextured) are their displays: the clock in the speedometer's, the gear in the rev counter's (UVs; the discs' own). Hubs: metres from the steering wheel's centre (the model's axes: x right, y up, z back); axis: the dials' face.
